items.title: How long does it take to find a job in 2026?
items.pt:
The typical unemployed job seeker in the United States had been looking for 11.5 weeks in September 2026. That is the median duration of unemployment in table A-12 of the Bureau of Labor Statistics Employment Situation release for September 2026, published October 2. Call it a little under three months.

items.title: AI-Driven Reproducibility and Analytical Robustness in Scientific Discovery
items.pt: Reproducible and analytically robust research findings are essential to scientific progress, but evaluating these properties typically requires costly manual effort. items.title: Quality-of-Transmission Estimation in Quantum Networks: Compute, Simulate, or Learn?
items.pt: Future quantum networks will rely on control-plane decisions such as routing, scheduling, entanglement provisioning, purification, and memory allocation. Each decision depends on a timely and reliable estimate of the quality of the entanglement that a candidate path can deliver, with end-to-end fidelity as a central metric. items.title: Self-Building Labs
items.pt: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) accelerate scientific discovery by automating experimental execution and optimization. AI agents can increasingly propose new experiments, but existing SDLs can only run the procedures they were built for. Adapting them to a new experiment still takes extensive manual engineering, which makes laboratory flexibility the bottleneck for scaling discovery.
